articleTitle: The Comparison of Microservice and Monolithic Architecture
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this day and age, people demand fast efficient and reliable applications. If a client has a high speed internet connection and required client’s app, the features such as reliability and efficiency can be provided only by the programmer. It is therefore essential to choose appropriate software architecture, before the implementation of functionalities that have been adopted to the project. Some of the most popular architectures are the Monolithic and Microservice architectures that can achieve the same result, however with different advantages and disadvantages. The purpose of this article is to compare the abilities and performance of the two software architectures – Microservice and Monolithic on the example of a web application in Java.

articleTitle: Arduino Based Ambient Air Pollution Sensing System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The proposed ambient air pollution sensing system provide real-time low cost flexible measurement of five most important for human health urban areas air parameters (such as CO, PM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</inf>, CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, temperature, and humidity) and transfer it to higher level applications for analysis and forecasting. Implementation features of developed system and proposed diagrams with their description bring a practical value.

articleTitle: High-Sensitive Sensors Based on QCR for Smart Devices
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Quartz crystal bulk acoustic wave (BAW) resonators reached with unique characteristics that allow us to use them in both oscillators and filter schemes. Smart sensors based on BAW quartz crystal resonators used for pressure, humidity, and temperature measuring. To extend the functionality of such device sensors construction with a modulated inter-electrode gap used. Two basic designs for multicore BAW sensors with a modulated inter-electrode air- gap are developed and proved. The model to describe the parameters of the equivalent circuit of devices presented, and modeling carried out. The resulting devices have improved characteristics for special applications.

articleTitle: Simulation of Acoustophoretic Separation of Microplastic Particles in mkFluidic Lab-chip
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this research we propose a simulation study of the acoustophoretic motion of microplastic particles suspended in a water-filled microchannel. The mechanism of acoustofluidic microparticles sorting was analyzed in dedicated originally designed Lab-chip device. Under the action of acoustic waves, the microparticles are focused at the points of the acoustic pressure nodes and transported further for detection and analysis.

articleTitle: Information Technology of the Increasing Sensors Term of Use Considering Their Movement
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In the paper introduced approach of solving problem of sensors' energy efficient. The solution of this problem is achieved by regulating their coverage radiuses. According to this approach a corresponding mathematical model in optimization problem form was presented and information technology with system architecture that allows decrease energy use of sensors of its realization. This optimization is performed by changing sensors' coverage zones with selected criteria of minimum zones intersection. Described method of calculating coverage zone. Also results of using presented technology were introduced.

articleTitle: Application of Correlation Analysis for Impact Assessment of Air Quality on the Possibility of Using Chosen Source of Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This publication presents the application of correlation analysis to the study on the possibilities of solar energy use. It is shown the assessment of the impact of air quality on the possibility of using chosen source of renewable energy. The most intense effects of poor air quality can be observed in urban areas where human activities generate pollution in various forms. The aim of the analysis was to investigate the relationship between the amount of solar radiation reaching solar panels and atmospheric pollution caused by climatic and anthropogenic factors in the designated location. Dependency analysis between the experimental data and the amount of light intensity were conducted by selected statistical correlation tests. The Matlab / Simulink software was used for calculations.

articleTitle: Assisted Living System Architecture Based on Bluetooth low Energy and Wearable Sensors
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The design of wearable sensors and development of novel wireless radio protocols drive advances in the assisted living technology which is a promising approach in terms of future domestic healthcare. In this paper we propose the system architecture for vital signs monitoring in home conditions. The prototype device is based on the microcontroller supporting Bluetooth Low Energy which may be used for medical data transfer in assisted living applications. We developed a respiration rate sensor and thermometer pickup to provide basic measurements of physiological signals. We tested a range of proposed wireless system in urban conditions. The temperature and respiration rate was then recorded to verify the system operation. We measured the power consumption to evaluate the low energy performance of the device which is vital aspect of the telemedical wearable system.

articleTitle: The use of Automation Systems in Ventilation Stations as a Support in the Process of Generating Cold for the Needs of Central Air Conditioning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This publication presents the use of an automatic system in ventilation stations as a support in the process of generating cold for the needs of central air conditioning. The article presents the use of a fan station installation using atmospheric air to cool water. The free cooling system is part of the refrigeration system that is used to produce chilled water in absorption and compressor coolers. The system works when the air temperature is lower than the temperature of the water returning from the underground part of the installation to the cooling system. The effective operation of the free cooling installation takes place from autumn to spring. The system switches on automatically when the air temperature drops below 15°C. In addition, if the air temperature drops below 1.5°C, one of the system's cooling lines is turned off and the free cooling installation takes over the role of the entire cooling system. The average cooling capacity of the installation in winter is about 1.5 MW. The use of this technology generates considerable savings in electricity and heat consumption, which would have to be used to produce cold.

articleTitle: Algorithm of Tunning Heating Source Thermophysical Parameters in Smart Home
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: A development of the efficient smart home energy management systems requires understanding of the heating behavior. Part and parcel of this process is thermal parameters of heating sources which define the effectiveness of energy usage. In this paper we introduce a novel approach for the estimation of thermophysical parameters of heating elements. Based on the formulation of dynamic heat transfer problem we present a model that describes the heating process in a building with multiple heating sources. Within this model we propose an algorithm of determination the effective thermophysical parameters, where historical temperature and aggregated energy data are used in order to estimate unknown parameters. Also we present the algorithms for data preparation and renormalization. The latter means a transition from integral building parameter of heating sources to separate parameters corresponding to particular room heating element. Due to occurred errors during the computation, the presence of some incorrect values in provided time series and the ambiguity of calculation scenarios, the resulting parameters can be tuned to achieve greater accuracy. To do that, we propose an approach which involves the multivariate minimization of loss function using the genetic algorithm. The whole algorithmic pipeline is discussed in this report.

articleTitle: Synchronous Auscultation of Temporomandibular Joints Using Electronic Stethoscopes
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Auscultation of temporomandibular joints is often difficult for physicians to interpret. Sounds from two joints affect each other and can give an ambiguous diagnosis. This paper describes the proposed setup for auscultation using commercially available electronic stethoscopes with additional synchronization features. Synchronously acquired signals are information for further analysis using diagnosis supporting algorithms. The proposed method of synchronization is necessary for further research which we carry out in the field of TMJ auscultation. The result of the work is the development of a working setup compatible with stethoscopes. Verification of appropriate synchronization signal parameters has also been carried out, indicating the progress direction of the future signals analyzing and representation methodology.

articleTitle: Application of Information Technology Engineering Tools to Simulate an Operation of a Flow Machine Rotor
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This publication presents the application of information technology engineering tools to simulate an operation of a flow machine rotor. It was shown an assessment of the impact of a fan blade shape on the possibility of forcing to move an airflow in a wind tunnel. The work was focused on the description of issues related to axial fans and their application in wind tunnels. The types, properties and possibilities of using wind tunnels were also discussed. Experimental research on the existing rotor was presented. An analysis of geometric and flow measurements was carried out, and then a computer model of the rotor was created based on previous analysis. The operation of the designed axial fan rotor was simulated in the form of numerical computer analysis.

articleTitle: Acquisition of Signals in a Wind Tunnel Using the Dasylab Software Package
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This publication presents the use of the acquisition of signals in a wind tunnel using the DasyLab system to assess the suitability of selected airfoils for the power industry and is a presentation of their aerodynamic characteristics. Research experiments were carried out using the MCCOMPUTING USB 1608G modular measuring system. The publication is a description of the air profile using a prepared measurement system that allows obtaining the characteristics: polar profile as well as drag coefficient and lift coefficient depending on the angle of attack. The influence of wing mechanization on the characteristics describing the profile is also presented. The comparison of the profile analysed is presented publication and the profiles were compared based on the polar profiles, drag and lift coefficients as a function of the angle of attack of the profile. The DasyLab software was used for measurements and analysis.

articleTitle: The Development of Operation Algorithm of Heat Detector with Variable Response Parameters
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: It has been identified that there are objects where ambient air temperature changes not only as a result of a fire, but also due to the operation of technological equipment and harsh climatic conditions. These changes affect the timing of work for the fire detector. These facilities include boiler rooms, kitchens, dryers, vehicles, etc. The article substantiates the need to develop a heat detector that would change its response parameters and at the same time would not contradict the regulatory requirements for its class. There have been proposed algorithms for the operation of a heat detector which changes the value of the static response temperature and the rate of rise temperature at which it responds. The algorithm of operation analyzes the speed of raising the ambient temperature without information about the operating modes of technological equipment and sets new values of the response based on the analysis.

articleTitle: Built-In Processor for Sharing Passwords Through the Open Information Space
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The work suggests the microarchitecture of the built-in processor, which specializes in the implementation of an advanced algorithm Diffie-Hellman, which uses a one-way function based on cellular automata. In work, the well-known cellular automata has been improved so as to allow the creation of a difficult to predict one-way functions that can be used to generate encryption keys for information.

articleTitle: Application of Fractional Order Transfer Functions in Approximation of Voltage Divider With Supercapacitor Model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: A complex fractional order transfer function of the voltage divider on the basis of the supercapacitor has been approximated by a particle swarm optimization method using a number of simple fractional order transfer functions proposed, and such approximation accuracy has been estimated through comparison of transition and frequency characteristics. The advantages of approximating a complex transfer function of the voltage divider based on the supercapacitor using the fractional order transfer functions have been shown. A comparative analysis of the results obtained for the different transfer functions has enabled drawing the conclusion about high degree of their coincidence and the possibility of their application for further studies.

articleTitle: Sensitive Data Transmission System for Biopotential Measurements in Wearable Application
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper we present a wearable biopotential measurement system with expanded data safety feature. The proposed solution combines dry electrodes as a biopotential interface and Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) transmission which together with a pairing feature based on NFC aim to provide reliable yet safe data transfer. Electrodes were prepared as conductive pads made of composite with Multiwall Carbon Nanotubes (MWCNT) filler. Such a material is convenient for integration with textiles and provides required electrical properties. The main module of the system's electronic part is based on nRF52832 microcontroller with embedded BLE radio supporting Near Field Communication (NFC). The main focus of this paper is the development and testing of safety mechanisms in a short distance communication that can be implemented in medical data transfer

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Noise Influence on Operation of Capacitive Sensor Readout Circuit
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The paper presents time-domain simulation analysis of noise in capacitive analog readout circuit. The presented analysis identifies main noise contributor of the circuit as well as presents influence of environment temperature on noise. Comparison of schematic-based and post-layout extraction-based behavior is also conducted.

articleTitle: Development of Nano Cavities in Aluminum Oxide Membrane for Bioparticle Manipulation by Acoustophoresis Method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: For the development of biosensors functioning on single particle sensing principle, the technologies of micro mechanical fluidic devices development as well as particle positioning and control technologies in them need to be available. When developing the mentioned technologies, it is necessary to form the nano/micro cavities to trap or filter bio particles to be used for diagnostics function. In this paper fabrication of the nanoporous aluminum oxide membrane using a custom-made experimental setup with a two-step anodization process is presented. The process of the anodization divided into two-steps: mild anodization and hard anodization. Also finite element models for the analysis of the electrolyte temperature during electrolysis and acoustic pressure distribution and particles motion using acoustophoresis method were created and analysed.

articleTitle: L-C- Electronic Elements Based on Silicon Microstructures
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The aim of this work is to investigate the full resistance of non-crystallized and recrystallized polycrystalline layers in AC structures from 10 Hz up to 250 κHz in the temperature range 4.2 - 70 K. Samples of the crystals were doped with boron to get p-type conductivity. The concentration of charge carriers was from 2.4 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1s</sup> to 1.7 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>, covering the values of the metal-dielectric transition concentrations in silicon. The effect of laser recrystallization and concentration of boron impurity on the electrophysical properties of the material at cryogenic temperatures is determined. This is caused by contributions from various elements of the microstructure till the complete conductivity of the sample. The use of polycrystalline silicon in laser recrystallized crystalline SOI-structures is proposed for the creation of passive elements of microsystem technology. The operating ranges frequency were between 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>-10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> Hz.

articleTitle: The Importance of Factors for UV Ink Printing Process by Digital Printers
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The analysis of the factors that determine the quality of digital inkjet printing by devices using MEMS technology has been carried out. A multi-level model that determines the priority of their influence on the printing process has been developed based on the established factors, the construction of the oriented graph and the reachability matrices.

articleTitle: Modeling and Computer Analysis of Temperature of a Dental Crown Made of Isotropic Functionally Gradient Metal-Ceramics
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: A mathematical model for determining the temperature in a cylindrical shell made of isotropic functionally gradient material is proposed. A dental crown made of metal-ceramics is modeled by such a shell. The temperature regime of the shell under the action of a plane heat source is numerically analyzed.

articleTitle: Analysis of a Mathematical Model of Plate Structures Oscillations in MEMS
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: A mathematical model of describing the oscillations of longitudinal plate structures MEMS is proposed. This model contains a partial differential equation of second order in time and fourth order in spatial variables with conditions which describe the behavior of the plate at two time points. The conditions of existence and uniqueness of the solution of the problem are investigated, and the method of constructing an accurate analytical solution of a two-point time problem is developed. On the basis of this, processes in micro- and nanoscale plate structures and dependence their horizontal deflections on the material properties and parameters are studied. Specific examples show the application of the developed method.

articleTitle: Influence of Fringing Fields on Parallel Plate Capacitance for Capacitive MEMS Accelerometers
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper we present the influence of using basic capacitance formula of parallel plate structure. Such structure is used in typical MEMS accelerometer that have dimensions significantly affecting the precision of calculations. It is caused by electric field that occurs also outside the overlapping area of plates. Therefore, the real capacitance is larger than the calculated one. Moreover, comb-drive structures contains two capacitor of different gap sizes wherein the electric field distribution is not the same as for parallel plate structure. Thus, the knowledge about the amount of underestimation is crucial when estimating the device performance. The parallel plate structure in comb-drive is simulated in order to find the influence of geometrical dimensions of the structure on the underestimation caused by basic capacitance formula. Finger length, width, thickness and gap distance between fingers is analyzed. The results are presented as function of real to calculated capacitances ratio on all input parameters separately. Moreover, such dependencies are approximated with simple analytical functions. In simulations Comsol environment is used.

articleTitle: Errors Compensation of Ring-Type MEMS Gyroscopes Operating in Differential Mode
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This paper analyses errors compensation ability of differential mode of operation implemented in MEMS gyros based on planar micro-rings and micro-3D resonators such as micro-hemisphere, micro hemi-toroid and other micro shells which are bodies of rotation. It is shown when standing wave disposition is in between the electrodes there appear two angle rate measurement channels with different signs. With this, it turns out to be possible to compensate for errors caused by both external and internal destabilizing factors.

articleTitle: Simulation of the Termo-Force Behavior of a Conductive Cylindrical Implant in Unsteady Electromagnetic Fields
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In the paper, there is constructed the physicomathematical model of thermo-force behavior of a conductive cylindrical implant subjected to external unsteady electromagnetic radiation.

articleTitle: Organization of Decentralized Real-Time Information-Control System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The organization of a decentralized real-time information-control system is proposed in this paper. The topological and computational features of the system construction are determined. Methods for ensuring time synchronization of information parameters and their processing using spline extrapolation are developed. Based on the developed basic element the fault-tolerant regular structures for computer network of the information-control system are proposed.

articleTitle: Determination of Dispersion Medium Parameters by Intelligent Microelectromechanical System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The paper considers the possibility of developing and using a software complex for the discrete determination of physical and mechanical parameters of the dispersion medium. The peculiarities of recording the data obtained from the strain gauges of penetrologger with their binding to GPS coordinates are given. The expediency of using DAQ module USB 6001 with the developed complex of virtual measuring devices in a LabVIEW environment is proved. The system of transfer and formation of the relational database MySQL and cloud technologies is presented.

articleTitle: Predicting the Use of Solar Photovoltaic Panels for Generating Electricity in the Area with Air Pollution
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This publication presents the application of simulation software to evaluation on the potential of for generating electricity in the area with air. It is shown the valuation of the effect of air quality on the opportunity of renewable energy source using, as well. Strong effects of poor air quality can be detected in town where human activities make pollution in various forms. The aim of the analysis was to examine the relationship between the amount of solar radiation reaching solar panels and air pollution from nature and human activities in the chosen location. Dependence between the experimental data and the amount theoretically calculated amount of energy were conducted by selected statistical correlation tests. The Matlab / Simulink software was used for calculations.

articleTitle: Modeling the Thermo-Force Behavior of an Electrically Conductive Spherical Implant in Unstable Electromagnetic Fields
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper, there is constructed a physical- mathematical model of thermo-force behavior of an electrically conductive spherical implant under the action of external unstable electromagnetic fields. The criterion of physiologically comfortable condition of the patient with implant is formulated. The computer analysis of thermo-force behavior of implant depending on the parameters of electromagnetic action is performed.

articleTitle: EM Wave Scattering on Thin Flexible Films Supplemented by a Set of Micro Particles
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The problem of electromagnetic (EM) wave scattering on thin layer (film) in presence of a set of small particles is studied based on the asymptotic approach. The size of particle is of order less than the distance between the adjacent particles; the number of particles is big and they are distributed with peculiar density in the initial material. A close form of solution to the scattering problem is reduced. The scattering characteristics of structure are studied for the different geometrical parameters in the case of plane incident wave.

articleTitle: Adaptive Numerics for Linear ODE Systems with Time-Dependent Data; Application in Photovoltaics
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: We give a brief account on the numerical approximation of linear evolution systems with time-dependent data. In particular, exponential integrators of Magnus type are considered. As an application we consider a system modeling the effect of photon impact of electrons in photovoltaic cells, in form of a time-dependent system of ordinary differential equations (ODEs) of spatially discrete Schrödinger type. Adaptive tuning of time steps in course of the numerical integration is an essential point; this is based on recently developed computable local error estimators. Numerical results are presented.

articleTitle: Stiffness Matrix of MEMS on the Stress-Strain Method Basis
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In the paper a method is described that is used for constructing the MEMS stiffness matrix on basis of the stress-strain method taking into account the type of deformation that corresponds to the calculated stiffness component and the classification of forces contributing to each type of deformation.

articleTitle: Capacitance Deviations for Deformed Parts of Solid MEMS Sensors
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper authors presents considerations regarding capacitance deviations under structure deformations. This problem is very important because meaningfully influences on device sensing capability by changes of output capacitance and consequently values of electrical signal processed on Integrated Circuit level.

articleTitle: Simulation of Corrugated Graphene Structure by Microlevel Cellular Models and Gaussian Random Fields
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: Basing on the reviewed corrugated graphene structural features and their models, the article presents the method of corrugated graphene structure simulation by microlevel cellular models and Gaussian random fields, which brings scientific novelty. Described algorithms and implementation features have a practical value.

articleTitle: Identification of Combinations of Faults in Multilevel Information Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to solve the urgent problem of constructing infrastructure models of complex information systems and procedures for diagnosing them. Models, methods and information technology of diagnostics of information systems with multilevel structure that allow to identify combinations of hidden malfunctions that lead to their imposition at different levels are describes. The procedure for constructing a generalized intelligent diagnostic model and its individual forms, which reflect the cause and effect relationships between typical combinations of faults and corresponding changes in the values of the controlled parameters of information systems, is described. A method of constructing algebraic forms adequate to intelligent models of diagnostics is developed, which allows to use the algorithm of sequential analysis and screening of variants for the identification of combinations of faults.

articleTitle: Developing a Model of Cloud Computing Protection System for the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: This article proposes the use of a multi-agent approach when building a model of the cloud computing protection system of the Internet of things based on the reference architecture of cloud computing. It is proposed to build a system for monitoring user behavior in a cloud computing system using an automated model. The selection of a security agent is necessary on the one hand in connection with the increase in the number of commercial enterprises switching to the cloud computing platform, and on the other hand, with the need to protect data and resources on the Internet of things. The article also presents some scenarios for the interaction of actors based on a dedicated security agent. In this case, the security agent performs a controlling and connecting role between all the actors of the model, monitoring and recognizing unauthorized actions both by cloud users of the Internet of things networks and by actors of the cloud computing system of the Internet of things.

articleTitle: The Studying of Hydrogen Diffusion Non-Stationary Processes Near a Crack in the Field of Heterogeneous Mechanical Tensions for the Encapsulated MEMS Devices
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE XVIth International Conference on the Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design (MEMSTECH)
abstract: In this paper we study an elastic-plastic isotropic body weakened by a rectilinear crack, directed along the abscissa axis, under the action of stresses symmetrical about its plane. An approximate (analytical and numerical) solution of this problem is constructed under the condition that the hydrostatic deformation of the split expansion is approximated by a parabola. The concentration of hydrogen near the top of the crack is calculated.Note that when using the above calculation formulas, at each node we get several approximations to the exact solution. In the proposed methods, only three appeals to the right-hand side of the differential equation are necessary to obtain both the third order accuracy method and the two approximations (upper and lower) of the second order of accuracy.
